command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 10, one training per role (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 35)

metrics.arm: P_tdc: P_ts's flags (rank 32, aframe, rclip, rtclip, psupport, tscale) + --decouple; seeds 10-12; builds full, nobottle, noplate and the S3 creations
metrics.layer2_go: pp_l2's mapping, unchanged (S1 exact; S2 3F + OM in both layouts; S3 ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6, both atoms, both layouts, k in {1, 5, 10})
metrics.reference: P_pdc: P_pp's flags + --decouple, full, seeds 10-12 (same object-term design as P_tdc)
metrics.reported_no_verdict: (c) repeat full_tdcr vs full_tdc seed 10, whole state bitwise; (d) reuse full_pdcu (--reuse obj:full_tdc) vs full_pdc seed 10, whole state bitwise; (e) per-object factor variance across seeds under P_tdc vs the between-arm range of rounds 6-9; (f) P_tdc GO read
metrics.round_verdict: (a) for each seed 10-12 every object-term tensor (obj.*, rclip, rclip_p, home) of full_pdc equals full_tdc's bitwise; (b) every paired S2 episode's hold flag agrees between P2pdc and P2tdc (all tasks, both layouts, seeds 10-12). decoupled iff (a) and (b); 'decoupled in training only' iff (a) and not (b); 'not decoupled' iff not (a). Success for the failure streak iff decoupled.
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds
metrics.written_before: the round's checkpoint comparisons, its S1 read and any of its rollouts
